name: Harriet Hageman
summary:
Harriet Maxine Hageman (born October 18, 1962) is an American politician and attorney who is a United States senator-elect from Wyoming. Since 2023, she has served as the U.S. representative for Wyoming's at-large congressional district.
Born in Douglas, Wyoming, and raised on a ranch outside of Fort Laramie, Wyoming, Hageman holds degrees from the University of Wyoming and has spent her career as a trial attorney.
